odds.note_any: Whatever its hidden rank, this is the result.
odds.note_hidden: Based on enemy ranks you can’t see yet.
odds.note_known: Both ranks are known, so the result is certain.
wheel.all_done: That is the wheel. Now fight on it: the Daily Chakravyuha is the same wheel for everyone today, and Quick battle starts a full match.
wheel.astra.done: Agneyastra burns a piece of rank 4 or lower and reveals anything stronger. Each astra works once per battle; Brahmastra needs all five lamps.
wheel.astra.invoke.text: Every piece you take lights a lamp of Shakti; astras spend it. You have 3. Tap Agneyastra (it costs 3), then the hidden enemy two cells inward, then Invoke.
wheel.astra.title: One astra
wheel.drill: Field drill — look, volley, trap and fort (six steps)
wheel.first.blurb: Two pieces. Step in, then strike.
wheel.first.done: Move, then strike. When both ranks are known, the result is certain.
wheel.first.move.text: Tap your Maharathi (9) at the foot of the wheel, then the gold dot one cell inward.
wheel.first.strike.text: The enemy Rath (2) shows its rank. Tap it: the tag says Certain win, because both ranks are known. Then press Confirm strike.
wheel.first.title: First move, first strike
wheel.hidden.blurb: Strike a rank you cannot see.
wheel.hidden.done: It was a Divyadrishti (5), and your 9 won. “Likely” is based on enemy ranks you can’t see yet; once a rank is known, the result is certain.
wheel.hidden.strike.text: A “?” means a hidden rank. Tap your Maharathi (9), then the hidden enemy beside it. It says Likely win: it could be any rank they still have — even the Senapati (10), who beats you. Decide, then Confirm strike.
wheel.hidden.title: The hidden warrior
wheel.home_sub: Four one-minute lessons on the wheel
wheel.offer_body: About a minute each: a first strike, the turning wheel, a hidden rank and one astra. Then your first battle.
wheel.tap_first: First tap the cell where the Rath will land.
wheel.wheel.blurb: Predict where a piece will be carried.
wheel.wheel.done: The Rath was carried to the cell you marked, and riding the wheel revealed it. In battle, “Chakra turns in” on the left counts down to the next turn.
wheel.wheel.predict.text: Every 5th round the two inner rings turn one cell clockwise and carry what stands on them. They turn after this round. Where will your Rath (2) be? Tap that cell.
wheel.wheel.predict.wrong: Not there. Only the two inner rings turn, one cell clockwise: at the foot of the wheel that is to the left.
wheel.wheel.title: The wheel turns
wheel.wheel.turn.text: You marked it. Now end the round: move your Maharathi (9) one cell, and watch the wheel turn.
ladder.next: {b} takes the field against you next.
ladder.one_more: One more win over {a} and {b} comes for you.
ladder.more: {n} more wins over {a} and {b} comes for you.
daily.title: The wheel is closed. Break in.
fall.ours: No fighter of ours is left to stand. The fort is open, and it falls.
fall.theirs: Their last fighter has fallen. Nothing stands at the fort — it is ours.
end.movers_lost: Our last fighter fell on round {n}. The fort stood undefended, and it fell.
end.movers_won: Their last fighter fell on round {n}. Nothing stood at the fort — it is taken.
challenge.send: Send this battle to a friend
challenge.title: Take the fort in fewer than {n} rounds
challenge.lede: Your friend beat {opp} on the {field} in {n} rounds.
challenge.lede0: {opp} took your friend’s fort on the {field}.
challenge.same: You face the same enemy formation on the same field. You set out your own army.
challenge.failed: The challenge stands: your friend took the fort in {n} rounds.
challenge.failed0: The enemy that beat your friend has beaten you too.
challenge.avenged: Avenged: you beat the army that beat your friend.
challenge.beaten: Challenge beaten: {t} rounds against your friend’s {n}.
challenge.matched: Matched: {n} rounds, the same as your friend.
challenge.slower: You won in {t} rounds; your friend did it in {n}.
